label: Clinic systolic blood pressure from 140 to below 180 mmHg
notes: Upper bound is modelled as exclusive to keep severe hypertension at or above 180 mmHg outside this suspected-hypertension rule. Confirm this interpretation with the guideline authors.

label: Clinic diastolic blood pressure from 90 to below 120 mmHg
notes: Upper bound is modelled as exclusive to keep severe hypertension at or above 120 mmHg outside this suspected-hypertension rule. Confirm this interpretation with the guideline authors.

label: 24-hour ABPM average systolic blood pressure at or above 130 mmHg
notes: Observation code, component, 24-hour time aspect, aggregation, value, and unit must all apply to the same Observation.

label: 24-hour ABPM average diastolic blood pressure at or above 80 mmHg
notes: Observation code, component, 24-hour time aspect, aggregation, value, and unit must all apply to the same Observation.

label: Home blood pressure monitoring average systolic pressure at or above 135 mmHg
notes: Assumes the EHR supplies a validated HBPM average. Raw-reading aggregation is outside the first demonstrator scope.

label: Home blood pressure monitoring average diastolic pressure at or above 85 mmHg
notes: Assumes the EHR supplies a validated HBPM average. Raw-reading aggregation is outside the first demonstrator scope.

label: Clinic systolic blood pressure at or above 140 mmHg on at least two separate days
notes: Requires at least two qualifying Observations on distinct calendar days. Encounter linkage is not required, since many systems do not link observations to encounters.

label: Clinic diastolic blood pressure at or above 90 mmHg on at least two separate days
notes: Requires at least two qualifying Observations on distinct calendar days. Encounter linkage is not required, since many systems do not link observations to encounters.

label: ABPM and HBPM are both unavailable or impractical
notes: Must be supplied explicitly by the CDS client. It must not be inferred from the absence of ABPM or HBPM Observations.
